name: sept-oct-2026-attack-test
description: Test fixture for the three September-October 2026 incidents: the Sept 7 Mini Shai-Hulud resurfacing (blueai-cli@0.7.0, Aikido), the Sept 23 supplychain.local Go-binary worm (@memtensor/memos-cloud-openclaw-plugin@0.1.21, Aikido), and the Oct 8 tensorlake@0.5.144 ChainDrop-family compromise (Endor Labs/Socket/Aikido/OX).
